title: [throwaway probe C — plain prose] closing-keyword reading for #8476 step 1
body:
Throwaway target for the #8476 step-1 live reading. This issue is the **PLAIN-PROSE POSITIVE CONTROL**: the same throwaway PR will carry an unformatted closing keyword bound to this number. Its whole job is to prove the link mechanism was live and readable during the reading — without it, "no link on the fenced arm" cannot be told apart from "links only materialize on merge".

Closed immediately after the reading. No work is requested here.
